description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Fiscal Management Report - 2023 and Budget Economy and Fiscal Position (Reserved)
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the availability of the Fiscal Management Report 2023, which is issued under the Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003. The content focuses on statutory compliance with existing legislation (sections 4 and 7 of the Act) and the publication of official fiscal reports, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
